newsitem.title: USA: Jew arrested for placing bomb in Florida synagogue.
newsitem.headline: Jew arrested for placing bomb in Florida synagogue.

text.p: An Orthodox Jew is to appear in court in Jacksonville on Wednesday charged with placing a bomb in a synagogue to disrupt a speech by former Israeli prime minister Shimon Peres, police said.
Harry Shapiro, 31, who worked as a cashier at a gas station, turned himself in to police on Tuesday, Jacksonville police spokesman Gil Smith said.
The Jacksonville Jewish Centre received a telephoned bomb threat on Feb. 13 shortly before Peres was due to speak there.
No bomb was found and the speech went ahead.
But on Saturday, three children found a pipe bomb when they were playing at the centre. Police disarmed the device.
Shapiro has been charged with placing a destructive device and making a bomb threat. He is being held without bond.
